I downloaded this keyboard specifically for its voice-to-text capabilities, and while that feature works well, the app has a long way to go before it can serve as a primary keyboard replacement.

First, it lacks essential features found on standard keyboards, most notably glide or swipe typing. Without that core functionality, it’s hard to justify switching away from a default keyboard. Second, the user experience for voice-to-text is cumbersome: having to open the app to enable speech-to-text and then swipe back to your text field breaks the workflow.

Fixing these two issues would easily elevate this from a limited utility app to a four-star keyboard.

To bump it up to five stars would require new functionality. One suggestion might be the ability to polish what was just spoken with another LLM.
